selection.algorithm: Group official rows by (heuristic,gold_label,subcase); sort each group by SHA256(seed+'|'+pairID), then pairID; in sorted stratum order take first 20 whose pairID and exact premise/hypothesis pair do not occur in prior HANS80 or already selected rows. Sort selected rows by (heuristic,gold_label,subcase,pairID) and assign B001-B600.

candidate_set.selection_winners: The two WSC35 unique raw-count winners under imposed and repaired scores, fixed by the original cohort; no recalibration on HANS results. If either winner ties, report null comparison.

inference.input: ordered premise and hypothesis only, with opaque task ID; no source labels or metadata
inference.models_and_runtime: Use the same four pinned model snapshots, label mapping and CPU forward-pass settings as the local NLI protocol; run exactly all 600 rows/model; no result-dependent sampling or model replacement
inference.outputs: Persist each task ID, predicted label, raw three logits, frozen source and runner hashes, model revision, model weight hash, failures and timing; require all 600 rows per candidate for primary result.

analysis.binary_prediction: entailment if model predicts entailment, otherwise non-entailment
analysis.primary_metric: macro-average of the 30 official subcase accuracies, equivalent to the micro accuracy on this exactly balanced sample
analysis.primary_contrast: accuracy of repaired-WSC winner minus accuracy of imposed-WSC winner, fixed from the original WSC35 choice
analysis.secondary: six heuristic-by-label strata and three heuristic accuracies, with all four individual model accuracies and ties
analysis.uncertainty: 10,000 paired subcase-cluster bootstrap draws, stratified within the six heuristic-by-label cells (five subcases/cell), fixed observed WSC winners, percentile 95% interval, seed 2026111360; descriptive conditional sensitivity
analysis.stopping: Report all four complete candidates, zero/negative effects and ties; no threshold or early success stop. If any model is incomplete, report incomplete and do not present a complete-candidate winner contrast.

limits: A broader sample of the same HANS source, not a separate benchmark. HANS is publicly available and model pretraining exposure is unknown; syntactic templates and subcases remain dependent. It cannot independently establish a real user's choice, generalize beyond HANS, or certify the WSC recast's NLI labels.
